selection_order: All arms and both nested budget stages are frozen before acquiring any new labels. Q16 is the first 16 distinct eligible proposals of Q128 per composition, with no energy filtering.
new_roles: TRAIN only; keep original H0 VAL and TEST intact, fixed threshold schema.
update_control: Warm start from previous weights only, reset Adam/RNG/update clock in all arms including no-new-data control; 1000 optimizer updates per round; Adam lr .001, batch 512, beta_final .1 and reference_updates schedule, validation-beta .1, TF32 off.
planned_sensitivity: For Q128 additionally target 0.2 of weighted TRAIN mass for newly acquired examples within each occupied composition/energy-bin cell; reuses same acquired labels and identifies the weight change as a separate intervention.
evaluation: After each round, fresh common-namespace proposals with three independent fit seeds and frozen history, fixed per-cell attempt budget across arms; score with pinned UMA and, budget permitting, MACE. Report low and 9-cell balanced yields, unique-orbit counts, actual oracle queries, compute cost, no unsupported significance from 3 fits.
scope: Unrelaxed vacancy masks in one 48-site parent; no new DFT/MD or potential fine-tuning.
